verdict.rationale: Cursor Automations explicitly deliver this story: cloud agents run on cron schedules or in response to GitHub/GitLab/Slack/webhook/Linear triggers, configurable via UI, the /automate skill, or Marketplace templates, with managed always-on agents like Bugbot and Security Agents shipped out of the box. This is backed by first-party docs and a live API/OpenAPI spec for programmatic automation management. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification that scheduled automations reliably maintain/fix software over time (only vendor docs, no third-party corroboration in the evidence pack).
